editorial:
Imagine waking up every day with a plan that seems healthy but slowly takes over your entire life. You follow a woman who is totally focused on her weight and gym routine. At first, it looks like she just wants to be fit, but you quickly realize she is becoming obsessed. The vibe is very tense and makes you feel like you are right there in the room with her as she pushes herself too far. It is a scary look at how a simple goal can turn into something that controls your every move.

The acting is the best part because you really feel her stress and hunger. While the middle part of the story slows down a bit, the ending hits you like a ton of bricks. If you like stories that make you think about mental health and pressure, you will love this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the woman's body finally gives out because she stopped eating. She collapses during a workout, but the twist is that she still thinks she is just being lazy. She tries to force herself to stand up, but she dies right there on the gym floor. The movie ends with a shot of her calorie tracker still counting down, showing that her obsession killed her even when she was gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves character studies and intense dramas.
